hero.headline: Full automation for your eBay store.
hero.subheading: Pricing and template rules per product group, price and stock checks four times a day, item specifics filled in completely, automatic orders and tracking. Plus a Pending Actions screen that tells you exactly what needs you next.

why.sectionTitle: Every tool does the basics. The difference is everything else.
why.sectionSubtitle: Listing, ordering and tracking are table stakes in this category. SellerHill adds the tools that let you actually run your store differently.

groups.title: A different strategy for every product group
groups.description: Stop forcing one set of settings on your whole store. Set margin, listing template, stock, stock buffer and fee deductions per product group: one group for Mother's Day, another for automotive parts only.

sync.title: Price & stock tracked 4 times a day
sync.description: Source price and stock are checked four times every day, and any change reaches your eBay listing in the same pass. When even a daily check is rare, you stop selling what's out of stock and stop sitting on prices that lose money.
sync.caption: A check every 6 hours

specifics.title: Item specifics, actually filled in
specifics.description: We don't skip required fields with "Does not apply". Every attribute is matched to a value the eBay category accepts, so your listing shows up in buyers' filters.

actions.title: Pending Actions keeps you on track
actions.description: A stuck order, a disconnected account, a listing that ran out of stock… Everything waiting on you, on one screen, most urgent first.

supplier.title: Your supplier never shows
supplier.description: Images are uploaded to eBay's own servers, brands are stripped from titles, and tracking numbers are converted automatically. Your blacklist keywords are checked on every listing before it goes live.

price.title: Affordable automation
price.description: The complete professional automation set for a far lower monthly fee. Every feature is in every plan, automatic orders are unlimited, and plans differ only by listings, tracking conversions and Best Sellers browsing.

q1.question: What are Setting Groups, and why do they matter?
q1.answer: A Setting Group is a reusable set of a margin rule, listing template, stock, stock buffer and fee deductions. Instead of forcing one configuration on your whole store, you give every product group its own strategy: your Mother's Day products run on a seasonal margin and template, your automotive products on their own rules. Move products between groups whenever you like.

q2.question: How often does price and stock sync run?
q2.answer: SellerHill checks the source price and stock of your listed products four times a day. When price or stock changes, the matching eBay listing is updated in the same pass. And when an item sells on eBay, stock is reduced right away rather than waiting for the next check.

q3.question: How do you fill in item specifics?
q3.answer: We collect every attribute the source catalogue has for a product and map it to the fields the eBay category defines. When a category only accepts certain values, we pick the right one from its list. Instead of skipping required fields with "Does not apply", we fill them with real values, sending up to 45 specifics per listing.

q4.question: How does automatic ordering work?
q4.answer: When a buyer orders on eBay, SellerHill places the matching order from your connected Amazon account and ships it to the buyer's address. You set a spending cap per account; orders above it don't go through and wait for your approval on the Pending Actions screen.

q5.question: What is tracking number conversion?
q5.answer: The tracking number that comes from the source can reveal where the item came from. With conversion on, SellerHill converts it into a different, trackable number before uploading it to eBay. You decide whether conversion is on and which carriers it covers.

q6.question: Will my supplier's name appear on my listings?
q6.answer: No. Product images are uploaded to eBay's own servers, brands can be stripped from titles, and the description templates carry nothing that points to a supplier. The keywords on your blacklist are searched on every listing before it goes live; a listing that matches is not published.

q7.question: What does the Pending Actions screen do?
q7.answer: Anything the automation can't resolve on its own lands there: orders waiting for approval, listings stopped by your blacklist, disconnected accounts, active listings out of stock or plan limits about to run out. Items are ordered most urgent first and take you straight to the right screen.

q8.question: Can I change the listing templates?
q8.answer: Yes. Pick one of 12 ready-made templates, edit any of them, or write your own HTML template. Every Setting Group can use a different template, and the preview shows how your listing will look on eBay before you save.

q9.question: Do you store my card details or account details?
q9.answer: We don't store your card number; payments are taken on Stripe's secure checkout page and your card details never reach us. Your Amazon account's login and session details are stored encrypted, used only for your own operations, and never shared with any third-party application. The details are in our Privacy Policy.

q10.question: Can I use it from my phone?
q10.answer: Yes. SellerHill runs in your browser and the interface adapts to any screen size. Everything you do on desktop, including adding products, changing settings and following orders and pending actions, works from your phone, with no app to install.

q11.question: How is real profit calculated?
q11.answer: SellerHill takes the net earnings eBay actually paid you for the sale (after eBay fees) and subtracts what you actually paid for the order, including tax and shipping. Orders whose cost data isn't complete yet are labelled "estimated" and kept apart from your confirmed total.

q12.question: Can I try it before paying?
q12.answer: Yes, two ways. The live demo opens the whole app with sample data, no sign-up needed. Or create an account and start the one-month free trial, no credit card required.
